name: fakhri
description: Pakistan electronics & home appliances e-commerce platform

scripts.dev:infra: docker compose up -d postgres redis minio mailhog
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @fakhri/shared && npm run build -w @fakhri/config && npm run build -w @fakhri/prisma
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w apps/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @fakhri/shared && npm run test -w apps/api
